u0: Initial carrying phase: the agent holds the box and no fall is awaiting recovery. Keep possession, move toward the exit, and enter it while still holding the box for final success. If the box falls, the immediate next objective becomes picking it up on the very next action.
u1: A box fall has just occurred and the agent is empty-handed, creating an immediate-recovery obligation. On the very next action, pick up the fallen box; doing so earns a small recovery reward and clears the obligation, while failing to hold the box then leads to absorbing failure.
u2: The agent has successfully recovered after a fall and currently holds the box; the immediate pickup requirement was met and a small recovery reward was earned. Continue toward the exit while keeping the box, recover promptly if it falls again, and enter the exit holding it for final success.
u3: A later box fall has just occurred after a successful recovery, and the agent is again empty-handed with an immediate-recovery obligation. Pick up the box on the very next action to earn a small recovery reward and clear the obligation; otherwise the machine enters absorbing failure.
u4: The agent has recovered after a later fall and now holds the box; the tracked fall-recovery obligations have been satisfied. Proceed to the exit while retaining the box and enter it holding the box for terminal success.
u5: Failure sink: the agent did not have the box in hand on the action immediately following a fall, so the required next-action recovery was missed. This state is absorbing and no positive task reward remains reachable, even if the exit is later reached.
u6: Terminal success: the agent has reached the exit while holding the box after successfully handling any falls. The task is complete and no further objective remains.
